verdicts_or_reports.expected: One IrisSeed album card showing "2 items" (big.jpg and huge.jpg), as at the start.
verdicts_or_reports.observed: Albums grid shows two separate "IrisSeed" cards, each reading "1 items". Opening the first card lists only huge.jpg; the second card holds only big.jpg. Persists after leaving and re-entering the Albums tab.
steps: Start: IrisSeed shows 2 items (big.jpg, huge.jpg).
Albums tab > tap IrisSeed. Long-press huge.jpg > Delete (moved to Trash, 'kept for 30 days').
Back to Albums: IrisSeed reads '1 items'. Correct at this point.
Library > Trash > long-press huge.jpg > Restore selected. Toast: 'Item restored to gallery'.
Albums tab: grid now shows TWO 'IrisSeed' cards, each '1 items' (one shows huge.jpg, one shows big.jpg).
Open either card: it lists only one photo. Back out and re-enter Albums: same result.

verdicts_or_reports.expected: After 'Restore selected' from Trash, huge.jpg is back in the library: Media shows 2 photos (Media (2)), IrisSeed shows "2 items", and the photo is in the album grid.
verdicts_or_reports.observed: Trash shows "Trash is empty" and the toast says "1 items restored to gallery", but huge.jpg is not in the library. Media tab shows only big.jpg; filter menu reads "Media (1)" / "Photos (1)"; Albums shows IrisSeed "1 items" (big.jpg only). This persists after closing and relaunching the app.
steps: Start: IrisSeed has big.jpg and huge.jpg; Media (2).
Albums > IrisSeed > long-press huge.jpg > Delete ('Moved to Trash (kept for 30 days)'). IrisSeed now shows '1 items'.
Library > Trash > long-press huge.jpg > 'Restore selected'. Toast: 'Item restored to gallery'. Trash becomes 'Trash is empty'.
Media tab: only big.jpg is shown. Filter menu: 'Media (1)', 'Photos (1)'.
Albums: IrisSeed reads '1 items' with big.jpg only. Before the restore, Albums briefly showed two IrisSeed cards, each '1 items', one with huge.jpg and one with big.jpg.
Force-stop/relaunch via HOME + open app: still Media (1) and IrisSeed '1 items'. huge.jpg is not in Trash or the library.

verdicts_or_reports.field: Favorites grid vs Media content-type chip
verdicts_or_reports.expected: Favorites reads from the same source as the Media tab, so with the Media chip set to Videos (0 items) the Favorites grid should show no photo. Or at least the two screens should agree.
verdicts_or_reports.observed: With the Media chip on "Videos (0)", the Media tab shows "No videos found", but the Favorites tab still shows big.jpg (a photo) in the Today group.
steps: Favorite big.jpg (Media tab > long-press > More > Favorite).
Media tab > Filter icon > choose 'Videos (0)'. Media tab shows 'No videos found'.
Tap Favorites tab.
Favorites still shows big.jpg under 'Today'.
Repeated with huge.jpg earlier: same result (Favorites showed the photo while the Videos chip was active).
